blurb: Friendly and super attentive bar staff with an upbeat relaxed atmosphere. Touch tunes available so you can enjoy music of your choice. Weekend entertainment is held Thursday, Friday and Saturday. The Lounge has a laid back atmosphere, accommodating everyone who visits the establishment with an amazing drink selection! There is a pool table, darts, and game machine for anyone looking to unwind and have some fun.
